p.src: 1  I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, LORD, I will sing praises.

en: I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, LORD, I will sing praises.
u.src: 1  I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, LORD, I will sing praises.

p.src: 2  I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

en: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.
u.src: 2  I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

p.src: 3  I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.

en: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
u.src: 3  I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.

p.src: 4  A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.

en: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.
u.src: 4  A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.

p.src: 5  I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.

en: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.
u.src: 5  I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.

p.src: 6  My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

en: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.
u.src: 6  My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

p.src: 7  He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.

en: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.
u.src: 7  He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.

p.src: 8  Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD’s city.

en: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD’s city.
u.src: 8  Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD’s city.
